question: What fluorine mass ratio was measured on the surface of the cathode rejects, and what after the Cyrene separation?
rendered:
The fluorine mass ratio was measured as 12.49% on the surface of the cathode rejects, and it was greatly reduced to 0.14% after the Cyrene separation. 

- value '12.49%': result; ratio; of fluorine element; measures mass ratio
- value '0.14%': result; ratio; of fluorine element; measures mass ratio
